$comment: PantryAtlas logo system. 'primary' is the live brand mark; 'secondary' is staged for preview builds and can be promoted later. To switch surfaces to the secondary mark for a preview build, run `BRAND_VARIANT=spark-bowl node ops/brand/apply-brand.mjs` (and set VITE_BRAND_VARIANT=spark-bowl for the app build). To make the switch permanent, swap the 'primary'/'secondary' values and re-run the script. Source artwork lives in web/brand/marks (in-app + lockups) and web/brand/tiles (favicons + PWA icons).
